description: Core listing/formatting helpers + their unit tests (net8.0, no WPF). This is the testable foundation the two WPF views depend on, so it lands first. Adds ServiceFileInfo, ServiceListRow, RelativeTimeFormatter, ServiceListingBuilder, and extends ServiceOrderManager with ListServiceFilesAsync + GetFilePathFor. Independent of FEAT-002's WPF work except that FEAT-002 consumes these APIs. Implements design.md items 1-5b, 17, 18 and the Testability/Error-handling sections.
steps: Add WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/ServiceFileInfo.cs: public sealed record ServiceFileInfo(string FilePath, DateTime LastWriteTimeUtc, WorshipPlayer.Core.Models.ServiceOrder Order); namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Models.

Add WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/ServiceListRow.cs: purely presentational type with string props Title, Type, DateDisplay, LastModifiedDisplay, LastModifiedBy, FilePath. No sort-only fields (no RawDate/StartTime), no WPF, no INotifyPropertyChanged (Decision 8). namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Models.

Add WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/RelativeTimeFormatter.cs: public static class with Format(DateTime whenUtc, DateTime nowUtc) returning 'just now' for whenUtc>nowUtc (clock-skew guard) and <60s, 'N minutes ago' for 1-59 min, 'yesterday' for the 24h window, 'N days ago' for multi-day, else a US short date via ServiceDateFormatter (reuse FormatUs or UsDateFormat with en-US). Pure/deterministic. namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Services.

Add WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/ServiceListingBuilder.cs: public static class with Build(IEnumerable<ServiceFileInfo> files, DateTime nowUtc) -> List<ServiceListRow> and Filter(IEnumerable<ServiceListRow> rows, string query) -> IEnumerable<ServiceListRow>. Build SORTS files first then projects (Decision 8): primary key effective-date DESC where effective date = info.Order.StartTime if present else ServiceDateFormatter.TryParseStoredDate(info.Order.Date, out d) ? d : (sort-last sentinel); secondary tiebreak info.LastWriteTimeUtc DESC. Projection: Order.Name->Title, Order.ServiceType->Type, ServiceDateFormatter.FormatUs(Order.Date, Order.StartTime)->DateDisplay, RelativeTimeFormatter.Format(info.LastWriteTimeUtc, nowUtc)->LastModifiedDisplay, 'Local'->LastModifiedBy, info.FilePath->FilePath. Filter: trim query; null/empty/whitespace -> return all; else case-insensitive Contains on Title OR Type (use StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase).

Extend WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/ServiceOrderManager.cs: add public async Task<List<ServiceFileInfo>> ListServiceFilesAsync() mirroring LoadAllAsync's scan EXACTLY (if !Directory.Exists(_serviceOrdersBasePath){CreateDirectory;return empty}; foreach Directory.GetFiles(_serviceOrdersBasePath,'*.json'){try{read+Deserialize with _jsonOptions; if order!=null add new ServiceFileInfo(file, new FileInfo(file).LastWriteTimeUtc, order)}catch{}}) using a BARE catch for parity. Return the list (ordering is the builder's job; returning scan order is fine). Also add public string GetFilePathFor(ServiceOrder order) => GetDefaultFilePath(order); (Decision 9). Do NOT change LoadAllAsync; keep GetDefaultFilePath and SanitizeFileName private.

Add WorshipPlayer.Tests/RelativeTimeFormatterTests.cs ([Fact] style like ServiceOrderPersistenceTests): assert sub-60s -> 'just now'; whenUtc>nowUtc clock-skew -> 'just now'; 1 and 59 minutes -> 'N minutes ago'; the 24h window -> 'yesterday'; multi-day -> 'N days ago'; older -> US short date. Pin nowUtc explicitly.

Add WorshipPlayer.Tests/ServiceListingBuilderTests.cs: assert ordering (StartTime beats Date; unparseable Date sorts last; LastWriteTimeUtc tiebreak); projection (Title=Name, Type=ServiceType, DateDisplay matches ServiceDateFormatter.FormatUs, LastModifiedBy=='Local', FilePath carried); Filter (case-insensitive contains on Title+Type, empty/whitespace query returns all, trimmed).

Add WorshipPlayer.Tests/ServiceListFilesTests.cs: IDisposable temp-folder pattern from ServiceOrderPersistenceTests. Write a few valid JSON ServiceOrder files + one corrupt file; assert ListServiceFilesAsync returns one ServiceFileInfo per valid file with correct FilePath and a non-default LastWriteTimeUtc, skips the corrupt file, and returns an empty list for a missing directory.
acceptance_criteria: ServiceOrderManager exposes public ListServiceFilesAsync() and GetFilePathFor(ServiceOrder); LoadAllAsync/GetDefaultFilePath/SanitizeFileName are unchanged (latter two still private).
ServiceListRow carries only display strings + FilePath (no sort-only fields).
dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests/WorshipPlayer.Tests.csproj passes all new tests and the full suite stays green (>= 460 + new).
findings:
Done; Core build 0 errors, tests 479 passing (460 baseline + 19 new). New public API for FEAT-002 to consume:

namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Models:
- public sealed record ServiceFileInfo(string FilePath, DateTime LastWriteTimeUtc, ServiceOrder Order)
- public sealed class ServiceListRow { string Title; string Type; string DateDisplay; string LastModifiedDisplay; string LastModifiedBy; string FilePath; } (all get/set, default string.Empty; display-only, no sort fields, no INotifyPropertyChanged)

namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Services:
- public static class RelativeTimeFormatter { static string Format(DateTime whenUtc, DateTime nowUtc) }  // 'just now' (<60s or future/clock-skew), 'N minute(s) ago' (1-59m), 'yesterday' (1-24h), 'N day(s) ago' (1-6d), else US short date (MM/dd/yyyy via ServiceDateFormatter.UsDateFormat, en-US)
- public static class ServiceListingBuilder { static List<ServiceListRow> Build(IEnumerable<ServiceFileInfo> files, DateTime nowUtc); static IEnumerable<ServiceListRow> Filter(IEnumerable<ServiceListRow> rows, string query) }  // Build sorts (effective date DESC = StartTime else parsed Date else DateTime.MinValue sentinel; tiebreak LastWriteTimeUtc DESC) then projects. Filter: null/empty/whitespace query returns all; else case-insensitive Contains on Title OR Type, query trimmed.
- ServiceOrderManager (extended, additive only): public Task<List<ServiceFileInfo>> ListServiceFilesAsync()  // mirrors LoadAllAsync scan, creates missing dir and returns empty, skips corrupt files via bare catch, returns scan order (no sort). public string GetFilePathFor(ServiceOrder order) => GetDefaultFilePath(order).

Notes for FEAT-002: pass DateTime.UtcNow as nowUtc when calling Build (RelativeTimeFormatter compares against LastWriteTimeUtc). LoadAllAsync/GetDefaultFilePath/SanitizeFileName left unchanged (latter two still private). No csproj edits, no new NuGet deps. No deviations from design.md items 1-5b/17/18.
